problems.stem: A force acts exactly perpendicular to the displacement of a particle. How much work does that force do?
options: The work cannot be found without mass
problems.explanation: Work depends on the force component along the displacement. A perpendicular force has zero dot product with the displacement and therefore does zero work.

problems.stem: Which force below is conservative in the idealized mechanical model used in this course?
problems.explanation: Gravity is conservative because its work depends only on the change in position, not on the path taken between the two states.
